cards.title: Marker dimming
cards.essence: Compaction dims markers before the cut instead of deleting them.
propositions: Markers before the cut are dimmed, not deleted.
Dimmed markers stay readable but are never followed.

flashcards.q: What happens to markers before a compaction cut?
